page: Microsoft Azure D8nlds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Dnldv6 family. This network-optimized virtual machine is built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. The hardware configuration is designed with a low memory-to-vCPU ratio, providing 16.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this server. The primary tradeoff of this configuration is the low memory allocation of 2.0 GB per core, which makes it less suitable for memory-intensive applications, while the lack of a GPU rules out hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the low memory footprint relative to the vCPU count offers a resource-dense option for workloads that require dedicated compute and fast local storage without the added cost of unused RAM. Suitable workloads include network-optimized applications, web serving, distributed systems, and lightweight database tasks that benefit from local NVMe SSD performance.
